title: OPERA-DSP v1.0 Released
body: Version 1.0 adds two major IP cores to the library: a streaming FFT block and a Constant False Alarm Rate (CFAR) target detection block. Both ship with functional models, fixed-point test suites, Sphinx documentation, and AXI4 and TileLink memory-mapped wrappers. See the release notes on GitHub for full details.

title: CFAR Block - CA-CFAR & Ordered-Statistic Detection
body: The CFAR block supports Cell-Averaging modes (CA-CFAR, GOCA, SOCA) and Generalized Ordered-Statistic modes (GOS-CA, GOS-GO, GOS-SO) built on a configurable Linear Insertion Sorter, with runtime FFT size and window configuration, optional log-domain thresholding, edge policies, peak grouping, and both AXI4 and TileLink interfaces.

title: FFT Block - Streaming SDF Radix-2 / Radix-2^2
body: The FFT block implements a streaming Single-path Delay-Feedback (SDF) Fast Fourier Transform for FMCW radar DSP chains. It supports Radix-2 and Radix-2^2 cores, DIT/DIF decimation modes, optional bit reversal, runtime FFT size and direction control, per-stage scaling with overflow status, SRAM-backed delay lines, and both AXI4 and TileLink interfaces.

title: OPERA-DSP v0.3 Released
body: Version 0.3 brings continued improvements to the core IP blocks and build system. Check the release notes on GitHub for full details on what's changed.

title: Magnitude Block - Squared, JPL & Log2 Support
body: The Magnitude block now supports multiple computation modes: squared magnitude, JPL (Jet Propulsion Laboratory) approximation, and log2 of real signals. Both AXI4 and TileLink interfaces are available with full test coverage - 1,368 tests per variant.

title: Windowing Block Available
body: The Windowing IP core is ready for use. Apply window functions to your radar data before FFT to reduce spectral leakage. Supports configurable parameters with both AXI4 and TileLink variants, backed by 672 tests per interface.

title: PreProcessing Block & Initial Release
body: The first OPERA-DSP release introduced the PreProcessing block for formatting raw ADC data from FMCW radar sensors. The block comes with comprehensive test coverage (4,884 tests) and support for both AXI4 and TileLink bus interfaces.

title: Project Announcement
body: OPERA-DSP is an open-source project aiming to make FMCW radar signal processing more accessible to researchers and developers. Built with Chisel and licensed under Apache 2.0, the project provides reusable hardware IP cores for the radar DSP pipeline.
